page.overview:
Who is Parasite of Mortrex?

The Parasite of Mortrex (Expiravis larvum) is a Tyranid bioform, the result of a Norn-Queen's genetic experiments and tests to enhance its broods. Named after its most disturbing ability and the planet where it was first encountered by Imperial troops, the Parasite of Mortrex is a bat-winged Tyranid creature evolved from Tyranid Warrior stock.

Next to its multiple claw appendages and fanged maw, the Parasite of Mortrex has a barbed tail and two other barbed appendages each tipped with a hollow tube, like a snake's fang, capable of implanting its still-living victims with Ripper parasite embryos. Within solar hours, or even after a duration as short as a few heartbeats in certain cases, the Ripper parasites mature and will devour the unwilling host from the inside out to fuel their accelerated growth.

Swooping on leathery wings, Parasites of Mortrex use these barbed ovipositors to drive Ripper gestation pods deep into their victims' bodies. These swiftly-growing creatures soon chew themselves free from their unfortunate hosts. Such was the fate of the defenders of the Imperial planet of Mortrex, the world first cursed by the Parasites' onslaught. Now they wreak havoc on the foes of the hive fleet by soaring over defences and seeding unlucky souls with nascent Rippers.

The Imperial Fortress World of Mortrex was one of the most heavily defended planets in the Segmentum Ultima -– a world where fortifications sprouted from every mountainside and bastions punctuated the landscape. For solar days, when Hive Fleet Kraken attacked, this formidable defence held back the vicious hordes. However, during the tenth solar day of the invasion, the Astra Militarum forces defending Mortrex encountered a winged bioform they had never seen before. Without warning, the monster dove towards the Human entrenchments, stabbing at the Astra Militarum guardsmen with lightning-quick strikes of its tail.
